name: cmux.signal.source/1
docs: Signal sources other extensions watch with cmux.watch. Each key of options.sources is a source of this app, named <app namespace>.<key> (acme/tickets declares open, watched as acme.tickets.open) and readable with the scope <app namespace>:read. The app publishes a value with signal.publish {name, value}; the daemon checks it against the source's value schema, keeps the last one, and tells the readers that hold the scope (stream <name>.changed) at most once per pollFloorSeconds, the newest value last. Readers read it with signal.read {name}.

props.sources: { [key]: { docs?, value: JSON Schema, pollFloorSeconds, staleAfterSeconds? } }

value.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) every published value must pass.

pollFloorSeconds.description: The shortest time between two change events readers get: publishes inside it coalesce into one, carrying the newest value.

staleAfterSeconds.description: How old a published value may be before a read says stale (default: none, a value stays fresh until the next publish).

status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
